execution_target: Mobin only; heavy laptop runs remain held
primary_outcome: Correct strict original-integer cost-change decisions before paid fallback, plus complete active cost

frozen_profile.ordering: Descending canonical width, index ties; stop at first conclusive sign

independent_fit_confirmation.selection: All declared fits and distinct proposals, including below-99%, wrong predictor labels, inconclusive certificates, regressions and expensive fallback. No quality-based seed exclusion.

scaling.data_contract: At least 16384 real held-out records disjoint from 3000 training rows. A new full-source cache hash and split must be pinned before outcomes. Never extend the historical 5000-row sample by duplication/padding.

comparators: Projection-free authenticated moments with paid fallback
Online exact affine with current request only
Same exact Full relation using PLONK backend sensitivity control
baseline_limit: The PLONK control uses an explicitly unsafe test SRS for timing only. It is not a secure deployment or a specialized optimized matrix-product protocol. That stronger comparator remains separate work.
execution_order: Validate small proof and tamper cases
Complete matched small server controls and three repetitions
Preflight constraints/memory for k sweep and new catalog sizes
Run larger matched proofs serially, retaining resource failures and all paid fallback
stopping_rule: No outcome-dependent stopping, cap/rank retuning or silent case removal. Resource/constraint guard failures are reported. Any redesign starts a new development plan and needs new confirmation.
replication_unit: Dataset/seed split configuration. Ages, k values, overlapping prefixes, representations and requests share data; proof count is not independent statistical replication.
implementation_status: Small matched queue, exact backend/online affine controls, frozen-profile native confirmation with disjoint large-catalog preparation, and per-case proof input preparation are implemented. The serial queue accepts those newly prepared case parents. Unit checks pass; real remote smoke checks must precede timing. No new heavy phase has started, and extended proofs have not been generated.
